title: Why Costco's Hot Dog Is Still $1.50

segments.say: This company refuses to make money on its hot dog.
Costco's hot dog and soda: one dollar fifty.
When an executive wanted to raise it, the co-founder said:
If you raise the price of the hot dog, I will kill you.
Because the hot dog isn't there to make money.
It's there to make you come back.
The real money is the membership.
About ninety percent of members renew every year.
That's over four billion dollars a year, before you buy a single thing.
segments.show: a year, before you buy a single thing

segments.say: More than half of Costco's profit.
You're not the hot dog customer. You're the membership customer.

description: Costco's $1.50 hot dog hasn't changed price since 1985, and that's the whole strategy. #business #money #costco
pinned_comment: Would you pay for a Costco membership just for the hot dog?
